description: Open Electricity (Open NEM) is a data repository run by Open Electricity (Open Source Australia). The site shows generation, demand, prices and emissions of the National Electricity Market and Western Australian grid by fuel type and region, with an API and downloadable records built from market operator data. Coverage: Australia. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as api, csv; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Open Electricity") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support electricity network and market studies of Australia. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
